This lichen is found chiefly in cool temperate climates, especially in underground environments, and is best known in north-western Endor. Even in suitable terrain, it remains easy to find.

This lichen is placed around a fracture after its fragments have been correctly set. It supports the treatment and doubles the natural rate of bone knitting. Unlike remedies that must be used fresh, Carpet Moss retains its potency for approximately a year when stored properly.
